title: Recorded higher radio beep and crackle
author: SEF7
processing: Retain the original third (approximately 2kHz) beep and following cutoff crackle from the receive cue source recording, at original pitch and speed. Extract 0.220–0.440s from the original C audition master, apply a 1ms fade-in, and preserve its mono downmix, 4ms ending fade and −4.917906dB gain. Encode directly from WAV as Vorbis quality 6.
